definition: Rods of Corti are two sets of firm rod-like structures in the organ of Corti that rise from the basilar membrane, lean toward each other, and join at the top to form a tunnel running along the organ. In this historical source, they are described as lying between rows of hair cells and were once considered possible structures involved in analyzing sound.
